description: The company's groups of projects — one per client, department or site: each with its projects and its people (everybody on its projects, and 'explicit' those the administrator put in by hand), and the projects in no group. In a project of a group, only the group's people are offered and found when picking a person; in a project in no group, only the people in no group; somebody on a project is always offered in it. The company's administrator only.
name: list_project_groups
title: List project groups
